# Generic header

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use the Generic header to give a public-sector service a clear branded header when it is not entitled to use the GOV.UK crown and logotype.

## When to use

- Use for services outside the GOV.UK proposition that want a compatible GOV.UK Frontend page structure without GOV.UK identity assets.
- Use a concise organisation or service name as the homepage link.

## When not to use

- Do not use it as an imitation GOV.UK header by adding the GOV.UK crown, logotype or protected identity styling.
- Do not replace the official GOV.UK header with this component when the service is authorised and required to use the GOV.UK identity.

## Anatomy

- **Header container (required):** A full-width header contains an aligned GOV.UK width container.
- **Homepage link (required):** A prominent text link names the service or organisation and returns to its home page.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Default | `div` | `govuk-generic-header` | A non-GOV.UK service with a short text identity. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- The Generic header requires no GOV.UK JavaScript and the homepage control is an ordinary link.
- Keep the link destination stable and preserve standard browser link behaviour.

## Accessibility contract

- Use a real link with a visible accessible name and sufficient contrast.
- Keep the text identity legible at narrow widths and high zoom.
- Do not communicate the service identity through an image or colour alone.

## Content rules

- Use the official public name of the service or organisation.
- Keep the name short enough to wrap predictably on small screens.
- Do not add the words GOV.UK or a crown mark unless use has been explicitly authorised.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.text`
- `govuk.color.body-background`
- `govuk.color.focus`
- `govuk.layout.page-width`

## HTML examples

### Text identity

```html
<div class="govuk-generic-header">
  <div class="govuk-generic-header__container govuk-width-container">
    <div class="govuk-generic-header__logo"><a href="/" class="govuk-generic-header__homepage-link">Example service</a></div>
  </div>
</div>
```
